sections.title: Intro bridge
sections.summary: Temporary cards bridge the finished briefing script into the playable encounter.

sections.title: In-car news broadcast
sections.summary: Readable in-game subtitles timed to the silent television footage in the presidential car.

sections.title: Car arrival
sections.summary: The president and director react to the broadcast, notice Zaucer Pizza, and prepare to leave the vehicle.

sections.title: Tablet preflight
sections.summary: Dr. Hwang checks the president's drawing and walks through the local probe controls before the delegation enters.

sections.title: Delegation arrival
sections.summary: The alien delegation enters and Dr. Hwang hands control to the player.

sections.title: Translator calibration
sections.summary: The player submits labeled drawings and builds stable response groups.

sections.title: Reactive guidance
sections.summary: Dr. Hwang explains validation results and how each submitted sample affects calibration.

sections.title: Alien reactions
sections.summary: Short reaction captions selected by alien satisfaction.

sections.title: Automatic translation proof
sections.summary: A new signal is translated using the categories calibrated by the player.

beats.condition: UFO VHS footage is playing on the in-car television
beats.sourceText: This footage of an unidentified flying object was recorded over Redmond, Washington.
beats.situation: Silent VHS footage opens the broadcast.
beats.beforeAction: The camera is locked in front of the in-car television.
beats.afterAction: Cut to the field reporter.
beats.stageDirection: Show as a clean game subtitle below the noisy television image.

localizedTexts.text: 워싱턴 주 레드먼드 상공에서 미확인 물체가 빛을 쏘며 날고 있습니다.

beats.condition: The field reporter clip is playing
beats.sourceText: An unidentified flying object has been sighted over Redmond, east of Seattle, leaving residents confused.
beats.situation: A reporter introduces the Redmond sighting.
beats.beforeAction: The archive footage ends.
beats.afterAction: Cut to an eyewitness interview.
beats.stageDirection: Do not show an advance prompt.

localizedTexts.text: 시애틀 동부 레드먼드 상공에서 미확인 비행물체가 목격돼 시민들이 혼란에 빠졌습니다.

beats.condition: The eyewitness interview clip is playing
beats.sourceText: I saw it with my own eyes! It appeared in an instant, flashed bright lights everywhere, then vanished into the forest!
beats.situation: A local eyewitness excitedly describes the object.
beats.beforeAction: The reporter narration ends.
beats.afterAction: Show the still photograph of the same object.
beats.stageDirection: The subtitle remains readable while the television graphics retain heavy VHS noise.

localizedTexts.text: 내 눈으로 분명히 봤다니까요? 순식간에 나타나 빛을 마구 뿜더니 숲속으로 사라졌어요!

beats.condition: The still photograph named ufo_oregon.jpg is shown as evidence from the same Redmond incident
beats.sourceText: This is a still photograph of the same unidentified object seen over Redmond.
beats.situation: The broadcast holds on a photograph of the same UFO; the source filename is not story canon.
beats.beforeAction: The eyewitness interview ends.
beats.afterAction: Cut to the Air Force press conference.
beats.stageDirection: Do not describe this as a separate Oregon sighting.

localizedTexts.text: 레드먼드 상공에서 목격된 동일 미확인 물체의 기록 사진입니다.

beats.condition: The Air Force press conference clip begins
beats.sourceText: We believe last night's lights were caused by Venus, a weather balloon, and a nearby base's nighttime flare exercise appearing together by coincidence.
beats.situation: An Air Force spokesperson offers an implausible official explanation.
beats.beforeAction: The still photograph leaves the screen.
beats.afterAction: The spokesperson warns against spreading rumors.
beats.stageDirection: Keep the delivery dry and official.

localizedTexts.text: 어젯밤 목격된 불빛은 금성, 기상관측용 풍선, 그리고 인근 기지의 야간 조명탄 훈련이 우연히 겹쳐 보인 것으로 판단됩니다.

beats.condition: The Air Force press conference continues
beats.sourceText: Be advised that spreading baseless rumors and causing public disorder may result in prosecution.
beats.situation: The spokesperson ends the explanation with a threat.
beats.beforeAction: The official explanation concludes.
beats.afterAction: The television powers off.
beats.stageDirection: Do not show an advance prompt.

localizedTexts.text: 근거 없는 소문으로 혼란을 퍼뜨릴 경우 처벌받을 수 있으니 주의하시기 바랍니다.

beats.condition: The in-car television has powered off and the view returns to the president.
beats.sourceText: Will people really believe this? They are not idiots. There were too many witnesses.
beats.situation: The president reacts to the implausible official explanation.
beats.beforeAction: The television cuts to black.
beats.afterAction: The director defends the cover story.
beats.stageDirection: Keep the player seated in the car; movement and interaction remain locked.

localizedTexts.text: 이걸 사람들이 믿을까? 사람들이 바보도 아니고. 본 사람이 한둘이어야지.

beats.condition: The president questions the cover story.
beats.sourceText: It was the best option available, Mr. President.
beats.situation: The director gives a restrained reply.
beats.beforeAction: The president finishes speaking.
beats.afterAction: The director announces the arrival.
beats.stageDirection: Do not give the player control yet.

localizedTexts.text: 이게 최선이었습니다, 각하.

beats.condition: The director looks out of the stopped vehicle.
beats.sourceText: We are almost there.
beats.situation: The car reaches the restaurant.
beats.beforeAction: The cover-story discussion ends.
beats.afterAction: The view moves to the restaurant sign.
beats.stageDirection: Hold on the normal car view before cutting to the sign shot.

localizedTexts.text: 이제 거의 다 왔습니다.

beats.condition: The camera holds on the Zaucer Pizza sign outside the vehicle.
beats.sourceText: Isn't this a pizza place? It is pretty quiet.
beats.situation: The president notices the unlikely meeting location.
beats.beforeAction: The director announces that they have arrived.
beats.afterAction: The director asks the president to enter.
beats.stageDirection: The player view is locked to SHOT_Pizza_Sign.

localizedTexts.text: 여기는 피자집 아닌가? 한가하구만.

beats.condition: The president finishes commenting on the restaurant.
beats.sourceText: Let me explain once we are inside.
beats.situation: The director redirects the conversation toward the concealed entrance.
beats.beforeAction: The president looks at the sign.
beats.afterAction: The player regains control and can use the car door handle.
beats.stageDirection: After this line, blend back to the president's car view and enable the exit interaction.

localizedTexts.text: 일단 들어가서 설명해 드리겠습니다.

beats.condition: first play and placeholder montage enabled
beats.sourceText: REDMOND UFO NEWS
beats.situation: A temporary storyboard card stands in for the moving-car news scene.
beats.beforeAction: First Contact mode begins.
beats.afterAction: Advance to the pizza restaurant card.
beats.stageDirection: Full-screen geometric news card.

localizedTexts.text: 레드먼드 UFO 속보

beats.condition: first play and placeholder montage enabled
beats.sourceText: ZAUCER PIZZA
beats.situation: The presidential party reaches the restaurant hiding the facility entrance.
beats.beforeAction: The news card closes.
beats.afterAction: Advance to the classified elevator card.
beats.stageDirection: Geometric pizza sign and concealed doorway.

localizedTexts.text: Zaucer 피자 비밀 입구

beats.condition: first play and placeholder montage enabled
beats.sourceText: CLASSIFIED ELEVATOR
beats.situation: The hidden elevator descends to the underground facility.
beats.beforeAction: The restaurant storeroom opens.
beats.afterAction: Advance to the translator briefing card.
beats.stageDirection: Sealed industrial elevator descending.

localizedTexts.text: 극비 지하 엘리베이터

beats.condition: first play and placeholder montage enabled
beats.sourceText: TRANSLATOR BRIEFING
beats.situation: Dr. Hwang finishes the briefing immediately before gameplay.
beats.beforeAction: The party enters the underground briefing room.
beats.afterAction: Cut to the live meeting room and begin the tablet preflight.
beats.stageDirection: Projector silhouette and translator diagram.

localizedTexts.text: 외계어 번역기 브리핑

beats.condition: first play and preflight enabled
beats.sourceText: Before they arrive, I need to see whether you can produce a usable visual probe.
beats.situation: The delegation is still outside while Dr. Hwang begins a local equipment check.
beats.beforeAction: The briefing ends and the tablet comes into view.
beats.afterAction: The drawing tools illuminate.
beats.stageDirection: Keep the tablet and its physical controls in frame.

localizedTexts.text: 데이터 수집을 시작하기 전에 저랑 먼저 연습을 해보시죠 각하.

beats.condition: first play and preflight enabled
beats.sourceText: The three illuminated controls are the brush, fill, and eraser.
beats.situation: The brush, fill, and eraser controls pulse together.
beats.beforeAction: The local preflight channel is shown on the terminal.
beats.afterAction: The line-width and color controls illuminate.
beats.stageDirection: Pulse only the three tool controls.

localizedTexts.text: 지금 점등된 세 버튼은 펜, 채우기, 지우개입니다.

beats.condition: first play and preflight enabled
beats.sourceText: These buttons change line width. Use the slider beside them to choose a color.
beats.situation: The line-width buttons and color spectrum pulse together.
beats.beforeAction: Dr. Hwang finishes identifying the tools.
beats.afterAction: The history and clear controls illuminate.
beats.stageDirection: Pulse the size buttons, spectrum, and color knob.

localizedTexts.text: 이 버튼들은 선 굵기를 바꾸고, 옆의 슬라이더로 색을 고를 수 있습니다.

beats.condition: first play and preflight enabled
beats.sourceText: Use these to undo, redo, or clear the canvas. When the drawing is ready, press Enter.
beats.situation: The undo, redo, and clear controls pulse together.
beats.beforeAction: Dr. Hwang finishes identifying the style controls.
beats.afterAction: All tutorial highlights turn off and the canvas unlocks.
beats.stageDirection: Pulse the undo, redo, and clear controls.

localizedTexts.text: 이쪽은 순서대로 전체 삭제, 실행 취소, 다시 실행입니다.

beats.condition: first play and preflight enabled
beats.sourceText: Draw one concrete object. No words, symbols, scenes, or extra objects.
beats.situation: The drawing surface is unlocked for the practice probe.
beats.beforeAction: The control walkthrough finishes.
beats.afterAction: The player draws and submits a local practice probe.
beats.stageDirection: Leave the tablet unobstructed after the subtitle closes.

localizedTexts.text:
사물을 아무거나 딱 하나만 그려주십시오.
글자나 기호, 복잡한 장면은 안 됩니다.
색깔도 사용해서 그려 주시면 알아보기가 쉽습니다.

beats.condition: practice probe passed or local analysis was overridden
beats.sourceText: Good enough. We have seen what we need; the practice sample will not be recorded.
beats.situation: The practice probe has cleared the local validation path without opening the alien response channel.
beats.beforeAction: The preflight result appears on the terminal.
beats.afterAction: The alien delegation enters and the real calibration round begins.
beats.stageDirection: Hold on the preflight result, then cut to the delegation entrance.

localizedTexts.text: 좋습니다. 생각보다 꽤 잘 그리시는군요, 각하.

beats.condition: first play
beats.sourceText: The delegation is in position. The terminal will record their response.
beats.situation: The suited aliens have taken their seats across the table.
beats.beforeAction: Camera finishes the delegation entrance.
beats.afterAction: Control returns and the terminal becomes the next obvious focus.
beats.stageDirection: Dr. Hwang speaks from beside the analysis terminal.

localizedTexts.text: 외계인 대표단이 자리에 앉았습니다. 이제 터미널로 저들의 반응을 기록하겠습니다.

beats.condition: first category with zero traces
beats.sourceText: We will begin with {category}. Select the terminal when you are ready.
beats.situation: The player has selected a calibration category for the first time.
beats.beforeAction: A category channel is opened on the terminal.
beats.afterAction: The player opens the drawing surface.
beats.stageDirection: Keep the terminal visible behind the subtitle.

localizedTexts.text: 우선 {category} 카테고리 데이터부터 수집하겠습니다. 준비되면 터미널에서 엔터를 눌러 시작해 주십시오.

beats.condition: first drawing opened
beats.sourceText: Draw one concrete object in the {category} category. One object only.
beats.situation: The drawing tablet is ready for the first sample.
beats.beforeAction: The player opens the sample channel.
beats.afterAction: The player draws a single object.
beats.stageDirection: Do not cover the active canvas.

localizedTexts.text: 각하가 {category}에 해당한다고 생각하시는 구체적인 사물 하나를 그리십시오. 하나만입니다.

beats.condition: first label input opened
beats.sourceText: Enter the name of the object. The machine needs the label to compare the signal.
beats.situation: A drawing exists but the system still needs its human label.
beats.beforeAction: The player confirms the drawing.
beats.afterAction: The player labels and transmits the sample.
beats.stageDirection: Focus remains on the terminal label field.

localizedTexts.text: 그린 사물의 이름을 입력하십시오. 신호를 비교하려면 표본 라벨이 필요합니다.

beats.condition: first accepted trace
beats.sourceText: One response trace recorded. Different objects in the same category should form a group.
beats.situation: The first useful alien response trace has appeared.
beats.beforeAction: The aliens react to the transmitted sample.
beats.afterAction: The player prepares another distinct sample in the same category.
beats.stageDirection: Camera has returned to the terminal trace display.

localizedTexts.text: 반응 신호 하나가 기록됐습니다. 같은 분류의 다른 사물들을 보내면 비슷한 신호끼리 반응 패턴을 관찰할 수 있을 겁니다.

beats.condition: second accepted trace
beats.sourceText: Good. We need {remaining} more different sample to stabilize the group.
beats.situation: A response group is forming but is not stable yet.
beats.beforeAction: A second distinct sample is accepted.
beats.afterAction: The player submits the remaining sample.
beats.stageDirection: Short confirmation over the terminal.

localizedTexts.text: 좋습니다. 다른 표본 {remaining}개만 더 있으면 반응 패턴을 특정해낼 수 있습니다.

beats.condition: required traces accepted for current category
beats.sourceText: The {category} response group is stable. Calibration is complete.
beats.situation: The category display has reached 03/03 and GROUP is stable.
beats.beforeAction: The aliens give a positive group reaction.
beats.afterAction: The player selects another uncalibrated category.
beats.stageDirection: Return from the alien reaction shot to the terminal before the line.

localizedTexts.text: {category} 반응 패턴을 특정 했습니다. 이제 {category} 카테고리에 해당하는 단어는 번역할 수 있겠네요.

beats.condition: all bootstrap categories calibrated
beats.sourceText: All {count} categories are calibrated. Let us see whether it can translate a new signal.
beats.situation: Every bootstrap category is stable and the translator can be tested.
beats.beforeAction: The final category completes calibration.
beats.afterAction: An unsolicited alien signal arrives.
beats.stageDirection: Hold on the terminal before cutting to the aliens.

localizedTexts.text: 총 {count}개 분류의 보정이 끝났습니다. 이제 처음 듣는 신호도 번역하는지 확인해 보죠.

beats.condition: automatic demonstration result displayed
beats.sourceText: It worked. Known categories are translating automatically; the unfamiliar part remains unresolved.
beats.situation: The terminal has translated known semantic segments in a brand-new signal.
beats.beforeAction: The raw alien signal resolves category by category.
beats.afterAction: Normal First Contact play continues with proven translation.
beats.stageDirection: Let the translated terminal result remain visible.

localizedTexts.text: 됐습니다. 보정된 분류는 자동으로 번역됐고, 모르는 부분만 신호 그대로 남았습니다.

beats.condition: the label repeats a sample already accepted for this category
beats.sourceText: The same sample repeats the same response. Try a different object in the same category.
beats.situation: A duplicate cannot add a new point to the response group.

localizedTexts.text: 같은 그림은 같은 반응만 반복합니다. 같은 분류의 다른 사물 그림을 보내 주세요.

beats.condition: the response is recorded but the sample does not advance the active category trace
beats.sourceText: The aliens responded and the data was recorded, but the drawing does not appear to belong to {category}.
beats.situation: Any category mismatch, contextual-only relation, or uncertain relation is recorded without advancing the active category trace.

localizedTexts.text: 그림에 반응해서 데이터도 수집되었습니다. 하지만 {category}에 해당하는 그림은 아닌 모양입니다.

beats.condition: an off-category response pattern becomes stable without an assigned meaning
beats.sourceText: A new response pattern is stable, but its meaning is unknown. Compare the samples and enter the meaning you want the translator to use.
beats.situation: A stable off-category pattern needs a player-authored meaning before the translator can use it.

localizedTexts.text: 새로운 반응 패턴이 관찰 되었습니다. 제출하셨던 라벨들을 보고 카테고리에 이름을 붙여주십시오.

beats.condition: the drawing surface contains too little visible information
beats.sourceText: The drawing is too empty to read. Draw one visible object.
beats.situation: The vision check cannot find a drawing.

localizedTexts.text: 그림을 안그리신 것 같습니다. 그림을 하나 그려주시지요.

beats.condition: the drawing contains writing or symbolic notation
beats.sourceText: The sample includes text or symbols. Draw the object without writing.
beats.situation: Written language would contaminate the visual concept sample.

localizedTexts.text: 그림에 글자나 기호가 들어 있습니다. 순수한 사물의 그림만을 제출해야 정확한 데이터를 얻을 수 있습니다.

beats.condition: the drawing depicts a scene or action instead of one object
beats.sourceText: This looks like a scene or action. Draw one object by itself.
beats.situation: The sample needs one concrete subject rather than an event.

localizedTexts.text:
이 그림은 장면이나 행동으로 보입니다. 
순수한 사물의 그림만 그려주셔야 정확한 데이터를 얻을 수 있습니다.

beats.condition: more than one distinct object is visible
beats.sourceText: More than one object is detected. Leave only one object.
beats.situation: Multiple concepts would produce an ambiguous alien response.

localizedTexts.text:
사물이 둘 이상 감지됩니다. 
하나만 남겨 주셔야 정확한 데이터를 얻을 수 있습니다.

beats.condition: the vision check cannot identify one concrete object
beats.sourceText: The device cannot read one clear object. Draw one concrete object.
beats.situation: The drawing does not resolve into a useful single subject.

localizedTexts.text:
어...뭘 그리신건지 잘 모르겠습니다. 다시 한번 그려주실 수 있겠습니까?
색깔도 잘 사용하시면 더 알아보기 쉽습니다.

beats.condition: the written label does not describe the drawing
beats.sourceText: The label does not match the drawing. Enter the name of the subject shown in the drawing.
beats.situation: The visual sample is preserved while the player corrects a mismatched label.

localizedTexts.text: 라벨이 그림과 일치하지 않는 것 같습니다. 그림에 맞는 대상의 이름을 입력해 주세요.

beats.condition: the label names an action or abstract idea
beats.sourceText: The label names an action or abstract idea. Enter the name of one concrete visible subject.
beats.situation: The input is not a name for a visible subject.

localizedTexts.text: 라벨이 행동이나 추상적인 개념을 나타냅니다. 눈에 보이는 구체적인 대상 하나의 이름을 입력해 주세요.

beats.condition: the label is a category rather than a specific subject
beats.sourceText: The label is a broad category. Enter one specific subject name.
beats.situation: The label repeats a broad category instead of naming the drawing.

localizedTexts.text: 라벨이 너무 넓은 분류를 나타냅니다. 구체적인 대상 하나의 이름을 입력해 주세요.

beats.condition: the label names more than one subject
beats.sourceText: The label names multiple subjects. Enter only one subject name.
beats.situation: One label would map the alien response to several concepts.

localizedTexts.text: 라벨에 대상이 여러 개 포함되어 있습니다. 대상 하나의 이름만 입력해 주세요.

beats.condition: the label argues how the subject should be interpreted
beats.sourceText: Remove wording that argues how the subject should be classified, valued, or understood. Keep only the subject name.
beats.situation: The label contains an interpretive claim instead of a neutral name.

localizedTexts.text: 대상을 어떻게 분류하거나 평가해야 하는지 주장하는 표현을 빼고 대상 이름만 입력해 주세요.

beats.condition: reaction subtitle variant: mutter
beats.sourceText: The aliens are conferring with each other...
beats.situation: The delegation strongly dislikes the previous exchange.

localizedTexts.text: 외계인들이 서로 협의하고 있습니다...

beats.condition: reaction subtitle variant: mutter
beats.sourceText: The aliens exchange glances...
beats.situation: The delegation is dissatisfied.

localizedTexts.text: 외계인들이 시선을 주고받습니다...

beats.condition: reaction subtitle variant: mutter
beats.sourceText: The aliens observe quietly...
beats.situation: The delegation offers no strong reaction.

localizedTexts.text: 외계인들이 조용히 관찰합니다...

beats.condition: reaction subtitle variant: mutter
beats.sourceText: The aliens murmur amongst themselves...
beats.situation: The delegation gives a positive response.

localizedTexts.text: 외계인들이 낮게 웅성거립니다...

beats.condition: reaction subtitle variant: mutter
beats.sourceText: The aliens react with visible excitement!
beats.situation: The delegation is visibly excited.

localizedTexts.text: 외계인들이 눈에 띄게 흥분한 반응을 보입니다!

beats.condition: reaction subtitle variant: narration
beats.sourceText: They seem very displeased...
beats.situation: Narrated interpretation of a very negative response.

localizedTexts.text: 그들은 매우 불쾌해 보입니다...

beats.condition: reaction subtitle variant: narration
beats.sourceText: They do not appear to like it.
beats.situation: Narrated interpretation of a negative response.

localizedTexts.text: 그들은 마음에 들어 하지 않는 것 같습니다.

beats.condition: reaction subtitle variant: narration
beats.sourceText: Not much of a reaction.
beats.situation: Narrated interpretation of a neutral response.

localizedTexts.text: 반응은 크지 않습니다.

beats.condition: reaction subtitle variant: narration
beats.sourceText: A positive response.
beats.situation: Narrated interpretation of a positive response.

localizedTexts.text: 긍정적인 반응입니다.

beats.condition: reaction subtitle variant: narration
beats.sourceText: They seem quite impressed!
beats.situation: Narrated interpretation of a very positive response.

localizedTexts.text: 그들은 꽤 깊은 인상을 받은 것 같습니다!
